home.bio1: Gianvincenzo Alfano is a tenure-track assistant professor at the University of Calabria, where he also received his PhD in Information and Communication Technologies in 2020. His research is in knowledge representation and reasoning, with a focus on formal argumentation: the semantics and computational complexity of abstract argumentation frameworks and their extensions with supports, constraints, preferences, epistemic knowledge, uncertainty and quantitative weights, and their incremental computation in dynamic settings.
home.bio2: He also studies explainable AI, in particular the complexity and computation of counterfactual and semifactual explanations for machine learning models, and semantic imputation of missing values in relational databases. His work on argumentation received the Best Technical Paper Award at ICLP 2020 and a Best Paper Award at ACM SAC 2019.
